description: An absolute same-host "stylesheet" answers 200 with an HTML page (a soft 404): critical feeds the HTML to its css parser, which fails, so the sheet silently becomes empty.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on the page's own host fails the whole job (decision: shipping critical css that silently lacks the owner's own rules is worse than shipping none). A text/html or application/xhtml+xml stylesheet response is rejected (soft 404). (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: "same host" must compare host:port, as the url() rebasing does, or be injectable.)
